task.title: Do not count a self-link as an incoming link for orphan pages
task.body:
Why: packages/seo/src/domain/findings.ts:143-148 builds the incoming-link map from every link on every page including the page itself, so a self-link (a nav item pointing at the current page) hides an orphan page at findings.ts:237-238.
Outcome: `buildFindings(pages)` (src/domain/findings.ts) does not count a link from a page to its own `url` as an incoming link. A sitemap HTML page (`inSitemap` true, not the root path `/`) whose only incoming links are self-links yields exactly one `orphan-page` finding with `url` equal to the page url; a page linked from at least one other page still yields none. The `Observed same-origin link from <source>.` evidence lines of `broken-internal-link` and `link-probe-blocked` likewise never name the target page itself as its own source.
Proof: the implementer adds tests in tests/domain/findings.test.ts for a self-linked orphan, a self-link plus a link from another page, and a page that links to itself and to another page.

install: npm --prefix packages/seo ci --silent && npm --prefix packages/seo run build --silent
test: cd packages/seo && npx vitest run tests/hidden/hidden.test.ts
